title: Parades and pitching a B flat clarinet
summary: He played parades with most bands, never used E flat, and describes adjusting joints of a B flat clarinet to pitch any key.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone

blocks.x: Who did you play parades with?
I played parades with most everything I had here. Most everything I had here.
Did you play with the Excelsior?
I played most everything I had here. I went to every band that you mentioned, Innocent and all the others that say.
What, did you play E flat ever?

I never used an E flat. I used a B flat. It was a... E flat, I had an E flat and I gave it away. I don't know if they many men use E flat now. Most of them are playing with B flat.
